title: Five-step revenue analysis — Clearwave Systems
instructions: Clearwave Systems (calendar year-end) signed two contracts during Year 1. Apply ASC 606 to determine performance obligations, allocate the transaction price, and compute Year 1 revenue.

exhibits.title: Contract 1 — Metro Hospital
exhibits.content:
Signed and delivered **October 1, Year 1**. Price: **$1,800,000**, due in 30 days.

| Promise | Standalone selling price |
|---|---:|
| Imaging hardware (works without Clearwave's installation) | 1,200,000 |
| Installation (standard; other firms offer it) — completed October 1 | 300,000 |
| 24 months of technical support starting October 1 | 500,000 |

The hardware comes with Clearwave's standard 1-year warranty against defects.

exhibits.title: Contract 2 — Delta Logistics
exhibits.content:
Consulting engagement completed **December 15, Year 1**. Fixed fee **$60,000** plus a performance bonus based on cost savings achieved, determined in March, Year 2:

| Bonus | Probability |
|---|---:|
| $20,000 | 50% |
| $10,000 | 30% |
| $0 | 20% |

Clearwave has extensive experience with similar contracts and concludes that including the estimate will not result in a significant reversal.

rows.label: Number of performance obligations
rows.explanation: Hardware, installation, and support are each distinct. The standard warranty is an assurance-type warranty — not a separate obligation.

rows.label: Standard 1-year warranty
rows.explanation: It only assures the hardware works as promised.

rows.label: Timing for the support revenue
rows.explanation: The customer simultaneously receives and consumes support as it's provided.

rows.label: Contract liability at December 31, Year 1 (the customer paid in full in October)
Estimated bonus included in the transaction price
Contract 2 revenue for Year 1
rows.explanation: The service is complete, so recognize 60,000 + 13,000 = **73,000**; true up in Year 2 when the bonus is known.
